## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated (behaviour changes start with a failing test)
- [ ] `make smoke` run, if this touches linking, discovery, delete or cleanup (needs Ollama installed; not run in CI)
- [ ] README / TROUBLESHOOTING updated, if flags or user-visible behaviour changed
- [ ] `VERSION` bumped, if this should ship as a release (merging a `VERSION` change publishes it)
